entities.note: Head u 13073-13100, v 1571-1598; jacket v 1585-1630; waist bundle u 13050-13110, v 1616-1662; feet (13053-13077, 1715-1730) and (13109-13127, 1707-1724). Painted height about 144 px. The restyle has him holding a bundle above his head. The bending man in blue and the others at the cart's rear west of u 13050 are t1's.

entities.name: small slatted frame on a post between the south roofs
entities.what: Small triangular frame of thin slats on an upright post, standing in the gap between two tiled roofs of the south row: a small sign, a drying rack or a short fence panel.
entities.vis: part: foot hidden by the lower south roof
entities.note: Post u 13319-13321 from v 1617 down to ~1660; slats lean east to a diagonal ending at about (13347, 1645). Foot hidden at the lower roof's ridge. If it belongs to the south building (a railing or fence), structures_w may record it instead. The restyle draws a small patterned panel on a post.

entities.name: the crowd round the seated man
entities.what: Thirteen people under the east end of the big sloping roof: a man seated on the ground bends over dark patterned goods spread in front of him, and twelve stand round him in two rows watching (men in dark caps and long robes or short jackets, one youth, one small half-hidden figure); two old bare trees rise from the crowd's back.
entities.src: sections.md S4: a crowd around a seated man under an awning (≈ 13100–13450), identity unchecked; Hansen pl. 17–18 'the wheelwright, storyteller and fortune-teller'
entities.note: Counted head by head at zoom 3 on the scan: 12 standing heads plus the seated man. The seated man has no signboard, table or awning of his own (the 'awning' is the big sloping roof's east end), so storyteller, fortune-teller or pedlar stays open. Not members: the man in the shed behind (S4b.fig.man_in_shed_13220, looking away), the porter with the tall load below the crowd (S4b.fig.porter_tall_load_13402) and the man with a pole and basket at u ~13533 (t3's).

entities.name: the top-street stall
entities.what: A two-tier stall stand of round wares and a big tray on the top street, with a man holding a round basket standing at its west end.
entities.note: The young man walking at the stall's east end with something in his arms (head ~(13545, 400), feet ~(13550, 495)) is t3's by his foot; the loaded donkeys east of it (u ~13590-13650, v 330-460) are t3's.

entities.name: the open shop at the long roof's east end
entities.what: The east end of the open shops under the long roof: a counter at the back, a long table with a stool, a framed signboard, and in front a counter-table with two bowls where a man leans under the small tiled shed; a dim figure may sit at the back.
entities.note: The shops west of u 13050 (tables, the seated and standing people there) are t1's; the building, its columns and the small tiled shed are structures_w's.

entities.name: the saddled horse, the donkey and the men tending them
entities.what: A saddled dark horse stands facing west on the open ground below the shops; a man in a white robe stands at its head, a man in dark clothes bows at its flank under the saddle, and a man in a light robe bends east over a small donkey standing in front of it, toward a man at the donkey's head; another man bends over a sack beyond.
entities.note: t3's members (by their foot points), to join at the merge: the man at the donkey's head (cap and face looking down-west at u 13500-13525, v 957-990; body behind the donkey; foot est ~(13515, 1095)) and the man bending over a sack east of it (head ~(13565, 980), feet ~(13600-13620, 1080-1090)). The restyle shows 'five people round one horse' because it turns the donkey into a man in blue.

entities.name: the second palm-covered cart and its team
entities.what: The second big palm-covered family cart heads north-east: a light shaft ox and a lead ox on traces pull it, a bare-headed driver walks beyond the shaft ox, a carter walks at its hindquarters under the cart's front, and a porter at the cart's rear reaches up to its bed.
entities.src: 名画记: 大棕盖车 (pin 27) / 余辉: 豪车云集
entities.note: Only two oxen are drawn for this cart. t1 maps the people round its rear west of u 13050 (a man in blue bending at about u 12945-13027, v 1585-1735, and others at u 12900-12980) and the horse at u 12790-12980: add them to this group at the merge if they work at the cart. MERGE: t1's horse and the man in the big hat at the cart's rear stay their own group, S4b.grp.horse_12900: the horse is not harnessed to the cart and the man holds its head; the restyle's "man in blue bending" at u 12945-13027 is the horse's lowered head (t1, conf med), and its "figure in white" at u 12900-12950 is the big-hat man's light robe.

entities.name: long bench between the long table and the counter in the open shop
entities.what: A long narrow bench in the open shop, set at a slant between the long table (S4b.prop.table_13205) and the counter with the bowls (S4b.prop.table_bowls_13275) and receding up to the left like them, on thin legs.
entities.vis: part: east end runs under the counter's west end
entities.note: SECOND PASS (west): structures_w's S4b.bld.shop_hall_13170 lists 'benches' in the shop, and structures_w left 'tables B and C and the benches in the shop hall' to t2, but t2 recorded only the stool S4b.prop.stool_13130 (u 13116-13145, west of the long table). Strokes: a double line, the seat, (13152, 926) -> (13235, 970), slope +0.53 (it recedes up to the LEFT, like the tables); legs at u 13188-13192 (feet v ~988), 13208-13212 (~1000) and 13217-13221 (~1006). The counter's light top begins east of it at u ~13228 (v 953). Base = the middle of the legs' feet. OTHER READING (t2's, in S4b.prop.table_bowls_13275's note): the double line is the counter's west side '(13203, 955) -> (13257, 982)', and these legs are the counter's. Against it: five legs stand under the line west of u 13250 (13188, 13208, 13217, 13234-13239, 13243-13248), more than one table end shows, and the restyle draws a separate low bench there. If the lead keeps t2's reading, drop this entity. RECEDING EDGE (ground-level furniture, for the frame): seat (13152, 926) -> (13235, 970), slope +0.53.
